jestEvidence.whyRunTestsByPath: every drawn path contains the route group segment (maestro); a bare jest pattern is a regex and the parentheses would be read as a capture group

swallowProbe.reason: T-469's postgresCompat swallowing client cannot be reached by this draw: none of the twenty files references postgresCompat, getPostgres, db.query or an azure-read path, checked by grep over all twenty. The probe is recorded as not applicable rather than skipped.

censusFieldsNotTrusted.finding: The census's own per-file run and green fields were NOT used to write any verdict here. In buildCensus, loaded is the literal true, and run, green and covered are all assigned the same value, so green cannot disagree with covered and no file is ever executed. Measured on this base: 168 of 168 governedRiskFiles rows have run === green === covered, loaded is false nowhere, and no row has green true with covered false. 78 rows are published as green with zero executions.

suites.evidence: executed by this draw in one jest --runTestsByPath invocation: 6 tests, 1 failed, 0 pending
suites.rationale: Every assertion reads the bytes of a component file. It is RED because the product moved: it requires the loading shell to contain "Preparing Source command center.", a string that exists nowhere under src/ except this assertion, while the shell now renders aria-label="Source 360 is preparing". Updating the literal would restore green while leaving a control that a comment could satisfy, so the copy drift is the symptom and the scanner is the defect.
